## Topics in focus

[
[Ultra-High and High Pressure Valves]

### Hydrogen valves for your H₂ applications

Valves play a critical role in hydrogen applications. The variety of valves in this area is
impressive, ranging from simple shut-off valves to precise flow controllers, all of which must
afford safety, reliability and efficiency. From hydrogen production to fuel cell technology, the
correct selection and application of these valves is crucial for the success of hydrogen
applications.

][46] [

### Innovative solutions for a clean future with hydrogen

As an energy source, hydrogen has a significant role to play in the efforts being made to curb
climate change. As it is carbon-free, it supports the urgent need for decarbonisation – especially
if it is manufactured from renewable energies. For economical generation and use of green hydrogen,
however, plants and systems that are safe, low-maintenance and, above all, efficient are needed in
order to achieve the maximum overall impact.

][47] [

### Microsensors in laboratory automation and medical technology

Improve precision and reproducibility in laboratory automation: the use of microsensors brings more
efficiency and safety to your processes. Laboratories operate under the most demanding conditions.
Any manual intervention can lead to errors in sensitive processes. Bürkert microsensors, combined
with our fluidics expertise, can provide measurable advantages here.

][48] [
[Society. Environment. Business. - On green background]

### Sustainability

We are working on it – for environment, society and your business 

][49] [
[FLOWave]

### The future of contactless flow measurement: Type 8098 FLOWave

Tried and tested in the industry for years, innovative and reliable: optimise your flow measurement
with the hygienic Type 8098 FLOWave flowmeter by Bürkert and take your industrial processes in
pharmaceutical and biotechnology, and the food and beverage industry, to a new level!

][50] [

### Signposting the way to a regenerative economy

Bürkert is meeting the challenges of our time with a vision that goes beyond traditional
sustainability. The regenerative economy should actively contribute to protecting and strengthening
the environment and society.

][51]

## Topics in focus

[
[Ultra-High and High Pressure Valves]

### Hydrogen valves for your H₂ applications

Valves play a critical role in hydrogen applications. The variety of valves in this area is
impressive, ranging from simple shut-off valves to precise flow controllers, all of which must
afford safety, reliability and efficiency. From hydrogen production to fuel cell technology, the
correct selection and application of these valves is crucial for the success of hydrogen
applications.

][46] [

### Innovative solutions for a clean future with hydrogen

As an energy source, hydrogen has a significant role to play in the efforts being made to curb
climate change. As it is carbon-free, it supports the urgent need for decarbonisation – especially
if it is manufactured from renewable energies. For economical generation and use of green hydrogen,
however, plants and systems that are safe, low-maintenance and, above all, efficient are needed in
order to achieve the maximum overall impact.

][47] [

### Microsensors in laboratory automation and medical technology

Improve precision and reproducibility in laboratory automation: the use of microsensors brings more
efficiency and safety to your processes. Laboratories operate under the most demanding conditions.
Any manual intervention can lead to errors in sensitive processes. Bürkert microsensors, combined
with our fluidics expertise, can provide measurable advantages here.

][48] [
[Society. Environment. Business. - On green background]

### Sustainability

We are working on it – for environment, society and your business 

][49] [
[FLOWave]

### The future of contactless flow measurement: Type 8098 FLOWave

Tried and tested in the industry for years, innovative and reliable: optimise your flow measurement
with the hygienic Type 8098 FLOWave flowmeter by Bürkert and take your industrial processes in
pharmaceutical and biotechnology, and the food and beverage industry, to a new level!

][50] [

### Signposting the way to a regenerative economy

Bürkert is meeting the challenges of our time with a vision that goes beyond traditional
sustainability. The regenerative economy should actively contribute to protecting and strengthening
the environment and society.

][51]

# Cryocomp Cryogenic Valves & Vacuum Components

[cryogenic valves and vacuum components]

### Enhance Your Cryogenic System with

Cryo Valves ⏷ Vacuum Evacuation Valves and Operators ⏷ Cold Box Valves ⏷ Vapor Vents and Vent
Heaters ⏷ Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

Cryocomp specializes in vacuum insulated equipment for the safe and efficient transfer of cryogenic
liquids like liquid nitrogen, helium, argon, oxygen, and hydrogen. We make standard and custom
valves, bayonet connections, and evacuation components for vacuum jacketed piping systems and
containers. See our [Vacuum Piping System Design Overview][42] and find out how each component can
work in a cryogenic system configuration.

### Cryogenic Valves

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][43]

Cryocomp manufactures liquid nitrogen valves, liquid helium valves, and cryogenic solenoid valves in
virtually any configuration required. Valves are available from ½” to 2.0″ diameters in manual and
actuated, remote on/off, and flow control configurations. Our cryo valves have internal stem
assemblies and stainless-steel bodies that are also interchangeable, thus simplifying any needed
repairs, maintenance, or upgrades in the field.

### Vacuum Evacuation Valves & Operators

[[vacuum valves][vacuum valves]][44]
Important to the design of any cryogenic system are the vacuum evacuation valves and seal-off
valves. The valves are sized according to the enclosure dimensions and available from ¼” to 3.0″
diameters. We make matching seal-off valve operator tools for manipulation and positive sealing of
the valves. Our valves improve vacuum reliability and reduce product cost, with features like
flanged ends, spring-loaded action, and side ports available.

### Custom Manifolds

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual][cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][45]

Valve manifold assemblies can be as unique as the application. Most will include multiple valves.
These can be manual operation valves, actuated valves, or solenoid valves. Additionally, check
valves, pressure relief valves, bayonet connections, VJ piping, and elbows are useful and can be
incorporated into the design.

### Flexlines

[[cryogenic flexlines][cryogenic flexlines]][46]
This is an indispensable accessory for the safe and efficient transfer of liquid cryogens, including
liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, liquid argon, and liquid oxygen. Cryogenic transfer lines range from
the simplest non-jacketed flex line to a high-efficiency vacuum encased system. Cryogenic transfer
lines are available from Cryofab.

### Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

[[cryogenic bayonets][cryogenic bayonets]][47]
The bayonet set is a two-part mechanical joint that connects sections of vacuum jacketed pipe. Using
vacuum insulated bayonet connections allows for quick field installation of VJ piping systems with
minimum heat loss. Cryocomp bayonets’ features ensure continuous leak-free operation and minimal
heat loss.

## Buy with Confidence

Cryocomp has resources to help you research your options and specify the product that best fits your
needs. See [How to Specify a Cryogenic Valve.][48]

## Let Us Be Your Supplier of Cryogenic Valves, Cryogenic Vacuum Valves, and Cryogenic Bayonets

Each application and every customer are important to the experienced engineers and personnel at
Cryocomp Valves and our parent company, Cryofab Inc. Please allow us the opportunity to work with
you to develop the most efficient approaches to your cryogenic and vacuum systems challenges.
Contact us today at [[email protected]][49]

Heaters ⏷ Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

Cryocomp specializes in vacuum insulated equipment for the safe and efficient transfer of cryogenic
liquids like liquid nitrogen, helium, argon, oxygen, and hydrogen. We make standard and custom
valves, bayonet connections, and evacuation components for vacuum jacketed piping systems and
containers. See our [Vacuum Piping System Design Overview][42] and find out how each component can
work in a cryogenic system configuration.

### Cryogenic Valves

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][43]

Cryocomp manufactures liquid nitrogen valves, liquid helium valves, and cryogenic solenoid valves in
virtually any configuration required. Valves are available from ½” to 2.0″ diameters in manual and
actuated, remote on/off, and flow control configurations. Our cryo valves have internal stem
assemblies and stainless-steel bodies that are also interchangeable, thus simplifying any needed
repairs, maintenance, or upgrades in the field.

### Vacuum Evacuation Valves & Operators

[[vacuum valves][vacuum valves]][44]
Important to the design of any cryogenic system are the vacuum evacuation valves and seal-off
valves. The valves are sized according to the enclosure dimensions and available from ¼” to 3.0″
diameters. We make matching seal-off valve operator tools for manipulation and positive sealing of
the valves. Our valves improve vacuum reliability and reduce product cost, with features like
flanged ends, spring-loaded action, and side ports available.

### Custom Manifolds

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual][cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][45]

Valve manifold assemblies can be as unique as the application. Most will include multiple valves.
These can be manual operation valves, actuated valves, or solenoid valves. Additionally, check
valves, pressure relief valves, bayonet connections, VJ piping, and elbows are useful and can be
incorporated into the design.

### Flexlines

[[cryogenic flexlines][cryogenic flexlines]][46]
This is an indispensable accessory for the safe and efficient transfer of liquid cryogens, including
liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, liquid argon, and liquid oxygen. Cryogenic transfer lines range from
the simplest non-jacketed flex line to a high-efficiency vacuum encased system. Cryogenic transfer
lines are available from Cryofab.

### Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

[[cryogenic bayonets][cryogenic bayonets]][47]
The bayonet set is a two-part mechanical joint that connects sections of vacuum jacketed pipe. Using
vacuum insulated bayonet connections allows for quick field installation of VJ piping systems with
minimum heat loss. Cryocomp bayonets’ features ensure continuous leak-free operation and minimal
heat loss.

## We empower critical industries with   extraordinary solutions.

Flowserve manufactures and services pumps, valves, seals, and automation equipment that supports
essential infrastructure around the world.

[Learn more][157]
[Watch video][158]

Find the right products to power your business

Flowserve is committed to providing you with **world-class support.**

## Flowserve Officially Acquires Trillium Flow Technologies’ Valves Division  

Delivering a broader portfolio of engineered valve technologies, extensive nuclear valve solutions,
and high‑quality OEM lifecycle services for the world’s most demanding, high‑consequence
applications.

[Learn more][163]
[tricentric valve]

## Turbomachinery Lifecycle Expertise Now Part of Flowserve Services  

Flowserve has expanded our services portfolio through the acquisitions of Greenray and Allen Steam
Turbines™ to strengthen support for aging and legacy gas and steam turbine fleets. 

[Learn more][164]

## Introducing the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal for High‑Value Mixer Applications  

Flowserve has launched the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal — a carbon‑free, dry‑running sealing solution
engineered specifically for demanding top‑entry mixers. Designed to help reduce contamination risk
at its source, LMX delivers reliable performance when purity, precision and product integrity are on
the line.

[Learn more][165]
[LMX lip cartridge seal]

## Powering the Future of LNG Regasification  

Developed from decades of LNG expertise, the Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump – High Pressure (HP)
Series combines advanced cryogenic pumping technology with efficiency, reliability, and
serviceability to help operators lower costs and improve long-term performance.

[Learn more][166]
[Flowserve Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump - High Pressure (HP) Series]
Previous Next

## Product   Portfolio

**Flowserve offers the world’s most comprehensive portfolio of flow control solutions. **Our
portfolio of pumps, valves, seals, actuation and instrumentation systems, and more is engineered to
tackle our customers’ toughest challenges in fluid handling and control.

## Actuators and Instrumentation

## Energy Recovery Devices

**We design reliable flow control equipment for use in a variety of industries** including energy,
nuclear power generation, chemical processing, and flood control facilities. Our application

## Flowserve Officially Acquires Trillium Flow Technologies’ Valves Division  

Delivering a broader portfolio of engineered valve technologies, extensive nuclear valve solutions,
and high‑quality OEM lifecycle services for the world’s most demanding, high‑consequence
applications.

[Learn more][163]
[tricentric valve]

## Turbomachinery Lifecycle Expertise Now Part of Flowserve Services  

Flowserve has expanded our services portfolio through the acquisitions of Greenray and Allen Steam
Turbines™ to strengthen support for aging and legacy gas and steam turbine fleets. 

[Learn more][164]

## Introducing the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal for High‑Value Mixer Applications  

Flowserve has launched the LMX Cartridge Lip Seal — a carbon‑free, dry‑running sealing solution
engineered specifically for demanding top‑entry mixers. Designed to help reduce contamination risk
at its source, LMX delivers reliable performance when purity, precision and product integrity are on
the line.

[Learn more][165]
[LMX lip cartridge seal]

## Powering the Future of LNG Regasification  

Developed from decades of LNG expertise, the Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump – High Pressure (HP)
Series combines advanced cryogenic pumping technology with efficiency, reliability, and
serviceability to help operators lower costs and improve long-term performance.

[Learn more][166]
[Flowserve Cryogenic Submerged Motor Pump - High Pressure (HP) Series]

argon applications.

alloys — built to ASME standards.

## AMPO PODCAST

### In the new PROTALENT podcast, you’ll have the opportunity to discover firsthand what it’s like
### to work at a leading company in the energy sector.

In each episode, you’ll hear the testimonies of different people at AMPO —innovation, design, and
process engineers, sales managers, valve assembly technicians, AMPO SERVICE technicians, and more—
sharing their experiences, challenges, career paths, and the values of being part of this
international cooperative company rooted in Idiazabal.

Episode 9

#### Miren Salegi: Where quality takes shape

A new episode of the AMPO PROTALENT video podcast is now available, featuring Miren Salegi, a member
of AMPO's Production Services team. In this conversation with journalist Nerea Reparaz Beaskoetxea,
Miren gives an inside look at how AMPO's valve production process comes together, from defining
standards to fine-tuning every stage of manufacturing — including the painting area, one of the
final steps before a valve is ready for its customer. Throughout the episode, she explains what the
Valve Production Services team does on a day-to-day basis, how painting specifications are defined
together with customers, and how the team turns everyday challenges into opportunities for
improvement, combining people's input with data-driven decisions. Miren also reflects on the growing
role of digitalization in AMPO's processes, the close collaboration with other teams across the
plant, and what a typical day in her role looks like. Beyond the technical side, she shares her
personal experience at AMPO: the team spirit, the satisfaction of seeing her opinions genuinely
taken into account, and her honest advice for any young woman weighing whether to study engineering.

Produktlösungen nach Maß

## Lösungen für viele Branchen

Wir fertigen bei BUTTING nach den speziellen Vorgaben Ihrer Branche, in jeder technisch möglichen
Formgebung und gemäß aller gängigen Regelwerke. Bei uns finden Sie für jedes Ihrer Projekte die
richtige Lösung.

### Chemie

Für die Chemische Industrie sind wir ein starker und innovativer Partner. Deshalb setzt die Branche
auf unsere Erfahrung in der Edelstahlverarbeitung.

### Energie

Die Fertigung für die Energiewirtschaft erfordert ein Höchstmaß an reproduzierbarer Qualitätsarbeit.
Die Branche setzt seit Langem auf Lösungen von BUTTING.

### Fahrzeugbau

Für die besonderen Ansprüche der Industrie im Fahrzeugbau verarbeiten wir ein breites Spektrum an
Hochleistungswerkstoffen – auch in Sondergüten.

### Lebensmittel

BUTTING fertigt längsnahtgeschweißte Edelstahlrohre nach DIN EN 10357 für eine hygienische und
sichere Lebensmittelverarbeitung mit höchsten Anforderungen.

### Luft- und Raumfahrt

Bereits seit Mitte der 1970er Jahre fertigt BUTTING Edelstahl- und Titanbauteile für die Luft- und
Raumfahrt – vom Rohr bis zur einbaufertigen Baugruppe.

### Maritime Wirtschaft

BUTTING fertigt für die Maritime Wirtschaft bereits seit 1973 Behälter und Sonderbauteile sowie
kundenspezifische Rohrleitungssysteme für den Schiffbau.

### Maschinen- und Anlagenbau

BUTTING liefert maßgeschneiderte Edelstahl- und Sonderwerkstoff-Komponenten, die höchste
Anforderungen an Qualität und Betriebssicherheit erfüllen.

### Papier und Zellstoff

Bereits seit Jahrzehnten beliefert BUTTING die Papier- und Zellstoffindustrie mit Rohrleitungen und
Behältern aus Edelstahl – vom Engineering bis zur Montage.

### Pharma

Unsere längsnahtgeschweißten Edelstahlrohre nach DIN 11866 und ASME BPE gewährleisten das sichere
Handling sensibler und hochreiner Medien.

### Wasserwirtschaft

Unternehmen der Wasserwirtschaft vertrauen weltweit auf die Langlebigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit
unserer Edelstahlprodukte für die Wasser- und Abwassertechnik.

Kompetenz, die überzeugt

## Entdecken Sie unsere Expertise

BUTTING bietet umfangreiches Know-how in präzisen Fertigungstechnologien und vielfältigen
Weiterverarbeitungsmöglichkeiten. Hinzu kommen maßgeschneiderte Serviceleistungen, wie Engineering,

Raumfahrt – vom Rohr bis zur einbaufertigen Baugruppe.

### Maritime Wirtschaft

BUTTING fertigt für die Maritime Wirtschaft bereits seit 1973 Behälter und Sonderbauteile sowie
kundenspezifische Rohrleitungssysteme für den Schiffbau.

### Maschinen- und Anlagenbau

BUTTING liefert maßgeschneiderte Edelstahl- und Sonderwerkstoff-Komponenten, die höchste
Anforderungen an Qualität und Betriebssicherheit erfüllen.

### Papier und Zellstoff

Bereits seit Jahrzehnten beliefert BUTTING die Papier- und Zellstoffindustrie mit Rohrleitungen und
Behältern aus Edelstahl – vom Engineering bis zur Montage.

### Pharma

Unsere längsnahtgeschweißten Edelstahlrohre nach DIN 11866 und ASME BPE gewährleisten das sichere
Handling sensibler und hochreiner Medien.

### Wasserwirtschaft

Unternehmen der Wasserwirtschaft vertrauen weltweit auf die Langlebigkeit und Zuverlässigkeit
unserer Edelstahlprodukte für die Wasser- und Abwassertechnik.

Kompetenz, die überzeugt

## Entdecken Sie unsere Expertise

BUTTING bietet umfangreiches Know-how in präzisen Fertigungstechnologien und vielfältigen
Weiterverarbeitungsmöglichkeiten. Hinzu kommen maßgeschneiderte Serviceleistungen, wie Engineering,
Montage und Supervising. Mit Erfahrung, Qualität und Innovationskraft schaffen wir Lösungen, die
überzeugen.

[ Unsere Expertise ][130]
Download-Service

### Wissen aus erster Hand

Sie benötigen technische Spezifikationen zu unseren Produkten, weiterführende Informationen zu
unseren Leistungen oder zu unserer Unternehmensgruppe? Im Downloadbereich haben wir für Sie alle
relevanten Unterlagen für den schnellen Zugriff zusammengestellt.
[ Zu den Downloads ][131]
Karriere

## Bewerben Sie sich jetzt!

BUTTING ist ein in siebter Generation geführtes Familienunternehmen, das seit mehr als 245 Jahren
stetig gewachsen ist. Wir laden Sie ein, Teil unserer Gemeinschaft zu werden, und freuen uns, wenn
Sie Ihre Kompetenzen bei BUTTING einbringen möchten.

[ Zur Karriereseite ][132]

Unsere Standorte

## Weltweit für Sie aktiv!

Die BUTTING Gruppe ist mit rund 2.600 Mitarbeitern in einem leistungsstarken globalen Netzwerk
verbunden. Für Sie und Ihr Projekt arbeiten alle verbundenen Unternehmen Hand in Hand. Wir haben den
Anspruch, gemeinsam einen Beitrag zu Ihrem Erfolg zu leisten.

### BUTTING weltweit

Unsere Vertriebsstruktur basiert neben den international tätigen Unternehmen der BUTTING Gruppe auf
den Aktivitäten unserer Partner in verschiedenen Regionen der Welt.

CRANE ChemPharma & Energy designs and manufactures highly engineered products: check valves, sleeved
plug valves, lined valves, process ball valves, high performance butterfly valves, bellows sealed
globe valves, aseptic and industrial diaphragm valves, multi / quarter-turn valves, actuation, sight
glasses, lined pipe, fittings and hoses, and air operated diaphragm and peristaltic pumps.

## Welcome to **CRYOWorks **

CRYOWorks provides a variety of [products][124] for the storage, distribution, and transfer of
cryogenic fluids. For all of your cryogenic needs, call on us at [CRYOWorks.][125]

CRYOWorks is a leader in the field of cryogenic piping systems. We are proud to have engineered,
designed, installed, and maintained cryogenic transfer systems for a wide variety of organizations,
from startups to Fortune 500 companies. Our expertise brings value to a diverse set of
[markets][126] such as aerospace and defense, entertainment, clean energy (LNG and LH2), food and
beverage, semiconductor, electronics, industrial gas, solar, research and development, medical,
pharmaceutical, and automotive.

[CryoWorks]

As a leading cryogenic specialist, our customers rely on us to provide high-quality, dependable
[products][127] and exceptional [services][128]. These products include engineered cryogenic piping,
transfer hoses, valves, tanks, safety equipment, and complex turn-key systems.

We are prepared to provide and support your cryogenic needs no matter your company’s size,
specialty, budget, or project complexity.

industries. The range of industrial valves and equipment are extensively applied in oil and gas,
petrochemical, marine, and thermal power industries throughout the Middle East, Southeast Asia,

### Product Description

The industrial valves involve gate valves, globe valves, check valves, ball valves, and butterfly
valves in a full range of materials, namely carbon steel, stainless steel, bronze, super-duplex
stainless steel and special alloy steel like Monel.

FLOWORK emphasizes product quality as the basic pillar for the company in operation. All valves are
designed, constructed, and tested under the highest international standards by API, CE, ASME/ANSI
and ISO. In addition, FLOWORK performs a series of tests : cryogenic, fugitive emission and fire
test, etc.

[Fast delivery icon]

#### ... when you need a quick solution

We set the pace: fast quotations and short delivery times so that you can realise your projects
quickly and downtimes can be kept short.

We are happy to realise special valves according to your requirements, even for smaller quantities.
Our modular product range and 30 years of experience help us to do this.

Pneumatic solutions for industrial applications

The HAFNER Pneumatik product range covers every area of modern industrial pneumatics – from
[pneumatic valves][163] and [pneumatic cylinders][164] to [fittings][165], [function fittings][166],
[air preparation units][167] and [tubing][168].

Our in‑house developed pneumatic valves and cylinders are manufactured with HAFNER’s hallmark
precision, ensuring long service life and outstanding performance in industrial environments. The
reliability of our products is built on decades of manufacturing experience and continuous
technological innovation, enabling us to offer our customers the best possible valve and pneumatic
solutions.

HAFNER Pneumatik is dedicated to providing high‑quality solutions that are readily and flexibly
available to all our customers.

Today, the HAFNER brand stands for quality and reliability in the world of pneumatics. Through our
innovations and products, we provide our partners not only with components, but with comprehensive,
efficiency‑enhancing solutions for the future.

### Hy-Lok USA, Inc. is committed to providing high-quality valve and fitting solutions

## **Hy-Lok USA - The Industry Standard Valves, Fittings, and More**

For over 40 years, Hy-Lok USA has been supplying our partners with hard-working, adaptable, and
robust instrumentation tube [fittings][78] and [valves][79]. We understand that you work in
industries where there is little margin for error, so you need equipment that will consistently
perform in a variety of challenging conditions. That is why we have scoured the globe for the best
available alloys and [materials][80], which are built to work as hard as you do.

Our range of instrumentation tube fittings and instrumentation valves are designed to deliver
optimum performance, exactly when you need them. We stock a wide range of alloys in numerous shapes,
sizes, and fittings, and as we know your [industry][81] our experts would be more than happy to help
you find the best solutions for your current and future projects.

###  

[CONTACT US][82]

###  

### **Consistently High Quality and Performance**

Our high-performance instrumentation tube fittings and instrumentation valves have been carefully
selected and come in a variety of materials:
* [316 Stainless Steel][83]
* [Carbon Steel][84]
* [Brass][85]
* [Alloy 400][86]
* [Special Alloys][87]

We offer standard sizes and fittings, but we are also able to offer customized fabrications to meet
your own unique project requirements. Our attention to detail has seen us develop longstanding
relationships for companies in many industries such as [aerospace][88], [chemical
production][89], [pharmaceutical][90], [power generation][91], and [paper production][92] to name
but a few. Therefore, we are well-positioned to deliver the components you need.

### **The Hy-Lok Difference**

Over the past 40 years, we have worked tirelessly to find the best components and materials that our
clients can rely on. We will not be beaten on price and offer short turnaround times on many orders.
Our knowledge and expertise across many industries enables us to provide the best possible
solutions. So, whether you are looking to upgrade existing equipment or are looking to source
components for new projects, Hy-Lok USA has you covered. [Call us][93] today to discuss your
requirements with one of friendly experts, and find out how we can save you money without having to
compromise on quality

INDUS Vacuum and Cryogenic Systems, Mumbai, Maharashtra was founded in Dec 2013. Since then we are

semiconductor, Pharmaceutical, Healthcare and the Food industry to name a few. We create cost
effective solutions for any industry as per customer’s requirements and deliver in time.

Explore our specialized valve solutions engineered for gas processing, LNG, and cryogenic service —
including ball valves tested to API and ISO low-emission standards.

WHY CHOOSE LADISH?

## Manufactured. Verified. Trusted.

### Rapid delivery of corrosion-resistant alloys

Where overseas manufacturers may take 40–50 weeks to supply your valves, our standard delivery is
only 6–8 weeks, due to our extensive inventory and domestic manufacturing services.

### In-house services

Ladish Valves are a one-stop shop for end-user requirements, from PMI verification to specialized
cleanings and a variety of NDE tests to ensure your valves are kept to the highest standards.

### Full product traceability

Ladish has a fully traceable and documented manufacturing process, according to ISO 9001-2015. With
the Proprietary Ladish Quality Control Database, you’ll always know where and how we make our
products.

### Widely approved by a broad base of end-users across a variety of industries

Some of the largest and most successful chemical and petrochemical companies rely on Ladish valves
for their critical applications.

### Engineering and inspection support

Ladish has experienced in-house inspectors and engineers to provide critical assistance for the most
demanding applications and services.

documentation. Download specs or explore our product catalog.

Ladish Valves is part of the LPW Group — a family of trusted industrial brands, including Smith

### Air compressor

Atlas Copco’s ZH range is a superior centrifugal air compressor series available in the market. The
compressor provides unique features fulfilling customer expectations of low installation, operating,
and maintenance costs. It is considered the most advanced compressor with high reliability and
user-friendly interface. It packs high power with great efficiency guaranteeing uninterrupted air
supply. It provides compressed air at 7.5 bar after removal of contaminants.

##### Pre- cooling unit

Chilling unit is supplied with air coils fitted inside the circular tank and base mounted on the
skid. The unit contains Freon evaporation coils inside the tank with inlet and outlet connections to
Freon unit with sealed compressors of Hitachi/Mitsubishi, Japan brand, Danfoss Controls Expansion
valve and digital panel.

[Air compressor]
[Process skid]

### Purification Unit

Purification unit is used for removing impurities present in the atmospheric air. Impurities such as
oils traces, moisture, and carbon dioxide are eliminated. However, purification unit comprises of
the following components:

##### After Cooler with Tank

Air coils with M.S. Tank to cool air after the Air Compressor

##### Nitrogen Cooler with Tank

Air coils in two separate chambers in tank to Provides extra cooling by waste nitrogen

##### Moisture Separator (Purger)

It consists of pressure vessels with drain valves for removing condensate from the process air at
regular intervals of time. Two separators are provided.

##### Chilling Unit with Freon Unit

This consists of shell and tube type system. The air is chilled by Freon evaporative coils or by the
evaporative cooling of Nitrogen optionally. This system cools the process air to 12°C which is
necessary for removal of moisture from the process air.

##### Oil Absorber filled with Alumina

It consists of vessel packed with alumina balls with special filters at inlet and outlet. This is
used to remove any oil traces from the process air.

##### Molecular Sieve Battery on skid

Complete with 2 vessels, reactivation heater complete with Molecular Sieve designed for process skid
mounting.

### AIR SEPARATION COLUMN (COLD BOX)

We provide cryogenic type air separation unit complete with connected pipes, supports and proper
internal connections. The column is fabricated with the cryogenic grade stainless steel and argon
welding.

##### Main Heat Exchanger

It forms an important part of the column and is made with highest quality stainless steel. Two sets
of heat exchangers are supplied.

##### Lower column

It is an extremely crucial part of the air separation that is fabricated with high in-house
expertise for yielding high efficiency and reliability. High quality cryogenic stainless steel is
used in the construction. Construction is completed with ASME standards.

##### Evaporator – Condenser

One set of high quality condenser is supplied with the liquid N2 plant. Liquid nitrogen is deposited
at top of the condenser. It is made with ASME standard materials for long durability and
reliability.

##### Sub-cooler

One set of sub-cooler is provided at the time of installation. High quality materials fulfilling
ASME standards are used in the fabrication of the component.

[Instrumentation Panel of Cold box]

### Instrumentation Panel of Cold box

Instrumentation of panel of Cold is finished with world-class materials. Equipment used in the
construction of the material is sourced only from our approved list of European vendors. It consists
of the following components:
* • Pressure gauges
* • Auto intelligent temperature scanner
* • Online Digital purity analyzer for Nitrogen
* • Analysis valves
* • Liquid nitrogen controller

### Cryogenic Expander – (with Liquid Production System)

Cryogenic expander is hydraulically operated for providing automatic control of pressure and
temperature. It is fitted with a ball type valve at the inlet and outlet to ensure hassle-free
working for long durability and reliability. It is supplied with complete electric motor and
starter.

Liquid nitrogen pump is important piece of equipment provided with cylinder filling systems. The
pump takes nitrogen from the condenser of the column-cold box. Then, it compresses liquid nitrogen
to pressure between 150 and 200 bar that moves through a gas vaporizer inside the cold box-column

We provide cryogenic type air separation unit complete with connected pipes, supports and proper
internal connections. The column is fabricated with the cryogenic grade stainless steel and argon
welding.

##### Main Heat Exchanger

It forms an important part of the column and is made with highest quality stainless steel. Two sets
of heat exchangers are supplied.

##### Lower column

It is an extremely crucial part of the air separation that is fabricated with high in-house
expertise for yielding high efficiency and reliability. High quality cryogenic stainless steel is
used in the construction. Construction is completed with ASME standards.

##### Evaporator – Condenser

One set of high quality condenser is supplied with the liquid N2 plant. Liquid nitrogen is deposited
at top of the condenser. It is made with ASME standard materials for long durability and
reliability.

##### Sub-cooler

One set of sub-cooler is provided at the time of installation. High quality materials fulfilling
ASME standards are used in the fabrication of the component.

[Instrumentation Panel of Cold box]

### Instrumentation Panel of Cold box

Instrumentation of panel of Cold is finished with world-class materials. Equipment used in the
construction of the material is sourced only from our approved list of European vendors. It consists
of the following components:
* • Pressure gauges
* • Auto intelligent temperature scanner
* • Online Digital purity analyzer for Nitrogen
* • Analysis valves
* • Liquid nitrogen controller

### Cryogenic Expander – (with Liquid Production System)

Cryogenic expander is hydraulically operated for providing automatic control of pressure and
temperature. It is fitted with a ball type valve at the inlet and outlet to ensure hassle-free
working for long durability and reliability. It is supplied with complete electric motor and
starter.

##### Liquid Nitrogen Pump: Oil -free Stainless Steel Liquid Pump

Liquid nitrogen pump is important piece of equipment provided with cylinder filling systems. The
pump takes nitrogen from the condenser of the column-cold box. Then, it compresses liquid nitrogen
to pressure between 150 and 200 bar that moves through a gas vaporizer inside the cold box-column

international standards. The Company will maintain its position as a recognised leader in valve
design and manufacturing techniques at all times seeking to employ world’s best practice. The
requirements and recommendations of ISO 9001:2015 have been adopted without exclusions as the basis
for the Company’s Quality Management System.

# Maverick Valves - Netherlands

## We take Valve Design & Manufacturing to 4.0

We are a Dutch manufacturer and supplier of valves for high end applications in the Valve industry
such as Offshore, FPSO, FLNG, LNG, worldwide

[Our Products][10] [CONTACT US][11]

# Plant In-house activities

## Valve-holics to the Bone !

Our specialities are Severe Service Valves / Subsea Valves / Cryogenic Valves / Triple Offset
Butterfly Valves & Custom Made Engineered Valves.

We pride ourselves to be an facility complying with API-6A / API6D / API-6D-SS/ API-609 and API-600

[Our Products][12] [CONTACT US][13]

# Standard in Non Standard

## Your company can save big by giving Maverick Valves, the responsibility for your Daily Valve
## requirements ?

The majority of Our Valves are made to clients specifications and site requirements, we are the
Standard in NON Standard

[Our Products][14] [CONTACT US][15]

## ABOUT US

###### We are a Dutch manufacturer and supplier of valves for industrial applications in the Valve
###### industry, worldwide.

Maverick Valves (MV Nederland BV) is a young and dynamic organization, based in the Netherlands and
specialized in Subsea, LNG, FNLG and Critical application Valves.

Our clients and end-users are particularly operating in the market segments oil & gas, FPSO, FLNG,
chemical and petrochemical, both on-shore and off-shore.

Being the sister company of Maverick Valves manufacturing Italy SRL gives us a strong and unique
position in the valve market and really make the difference.

[Read More][16]

### Total Care

#### FROM BEGINNING TO END

Maverick Valves (MV Nederland BV) meets the demands in the market segments oil & gas, chemical and
petrochemical, both on-shore and off-shore by providing total care solutions for our valuable
customers.

One of our main goals is to meet and exceed our client’s expectations and in order to achieve that
goal, we developed a total care package.

[Read More][31]

## Manufacturing

###### USING THE LATEST TECHNIQUES, ADVANCED TECHNOLOGY AND SPECIALIZED EQUIPMENT

Maverick Valves Manufacturing Italy SRL is an independent company and sister company of Maverick
Valves (MV Nederland BV) and is completely specialized in the in-house manufacturing of standard and
custom made valves. This means that our state of the art production facility occupies not with sales
or commercial activities but with the Engineering, development, production and testing of
high-quality valves.

We produce special valves in various materials, such as high alloyed steels and titanium which are
designed and edited by our team of specialists. All material combinations can easily be adapted. Our
valves are made on demand according to the client’s specifications.

**speciality valves** such as Y-pattern and Bellows seal and valves for **specialised services such
as Alkylation, Cryogenic and Lethal service**.

All ORION valves are produced by employing the **best raw materials, carefully selected, correctly
identified and analysed**. The machining is carried out with the aid of the latest type equipment

to ensure that governing standards and tolerances are strictly complied with. ORION valves are
designed to the basic principle of hydrodynamics so that pressure drop and turbulence are reduced,
thus allowing a smooth flow of fluids with the minimum of resctriction.

used in the **Oil&Gas** and **Power Industries**.

stakeholders, highlighting the role of excellence and international presence of the Italian leading
industries.

industry professionals and organizations.

physical boundaries, to become a permanent and growing knowledge tool, excellent and dynamic: “A
continuous knowledge sharing platform for a successful future”.

###### Quality

ORION will be a provider of quality services and products, consistently meeting or exceeding our
customers' expectations. We will be an agile, highly responsive business unit; reactive to the needs
of our customers especially in regard to competitive features of our products, on-time delivery and
support. We will strive to deliver the promise at all times in all aspects of the marketing mix,
ensuring an image of reliability and implicit trust with our customers. We strive to be seen to be
determined, focused and straightforward business partners who are both flexible and consistent.

###### 
###### Environment

In consideration of the impact that valves can have on the environment, ORION strictly adhere to all
European rules on the matter of waste disposal, air emission, noises control, wastewater discharge.
ORION SPA also have constantly ongoing research and testing activities aimed at the improvement of
environmental performances of valves especially with regard to fugitive emission levels through the
stem packing box and body/bonnet gaskets.

###### 
###### Technology

The Company's equipment includes high volume transfer machines, bar machines, chuckers, NC lathes,
milling machines, drill machines, heat treatment equipment and a tool making/grinding shop. These
facilities are complemented through framework agreements with prime foundry suppliers, wich
guarantee the Company access to the most modern casting techniques and material treatment
equipments. ORION utilises the latest edition of SOLIDWORKS CAD system and COSMOS FINITE ELEMENTS
ANALYSIS engineering software for valve design purposes.

## C700 Series Single-seat Control Valve

C700 Series Single Seated Control Valve is a top-guided structure control valve, used in equipment
that can achieve air opening or air closing. The fluid channel of the valve body is in an S-shaped
streamlined shape, featuring low pressure drop loss, large flow rate, wide adjustable range, high
accuracy of the flow characteristic curve, large guiding area of the valve core, and good vibration
resistance. The control valve is equipped with a multi-spring diaphragm actuator, which features a
compact structure and large output force. It can be used to control various fluids with different
pressures and temperatures...
[Read more][65]

## Rising Stem Ball Valve

RAYS' rising stem ball valve is designed to operate without friction between the ball and the seat
during opening and to achieve zero leakage when closed. This makes it well-suited for demanding
conditions. The valve is made entirely of metal and is fire-resistant, capable of functioning in
extreme temperatures ranging from -196°C (320.8°F) to 538°C (1000.4°F). It can handle media with
particulates like sand and short fibers, and meets NACE standards for corrosion resistance, ensuring
it can resist sulfide stress cracking in harsh environments. The valve also features a self-cleaning
mechanism. When the ball is tilted away from the seat, the fluid flows 360° around the ball's
sealing surface, effectively removing any debris. This prevents damage from high-speed fluid flows
and keeps the sealing area clean. The rising stem ball valve is ideal for various applications
including exhaust, fluid transfer, pipeline isolation, bypass, product segmentation, and emergency
shutdowns, particularly where high switching frequencies and zero leakage in high temperatures are
required...

# Welcome to Rochelles Technomatics

A one stop solutions for all your sourcing needs. We are experts in development, sourcing and export
of Engineering Components, mainly for Industries like Incineration, Biomass and Valves. We offer
systematic warehousing of components and on demand delivery. Assemblies, sub-assemblies and

in sourcing and serving world renowned organizations around the world, we are one of the reliable
and professional partners for all your components and assembly requirements.

Products lines include all types of castings (Lost Wax, Sand Castings, Shell Moulding, Pressure Die
Castings, Green Sand Castings etc), forgings, ring rolling, machined components, fabricated
assemblies. We are well experienced in the production of components for Incineration Industry (Grate
Bars for all types of Furnaces, Fluidizing Nozzles, Worm Feeders, Dust Collector Cones, Boiler Tubes
and Protection Covers etc).

We also possess long-time expertise in supplying components for critical applications like Valves
for Cryogenic and other severe services.

We have an array of dedicated suppliers for Machining, Foundry and Assembly. Also, basic assemblies

of them. We are "Green" - Our premise is totally running on Solar Power - We care for our

# Welcome to Rochelles Technomatics

A one stop solutions for all your sourcing needs. We are experts in development, sourcing and export
of Engineering Components, mainly for Industries like Incineration, Biomass and Valves. We offer
systematic warehousing of components and on demand delivery. Assemblies, sub-assemblies and
fabricated components are one of our main stream businesses. Having more than a decade's experience
in sourcing and serving world renowned organizations around the world, we are one of the reliable
and professional partners for all your components and assembly requirements.

Products lines include all types of castings (Lost Wax, Sand Castings, Shell Moulding, Pressure Die
Castings, Green Sand Castings etc), forgings, ring rolling, machined components, fabricated
assemblies. We are well experienced in the production of components for Incineration Industry (Grate
Bars for all types of Furnaces, Fluidizing Nozzles, Worm Feeders, Dust Collector Cones, Boiler Tubes
and Protection Covers etc).

We also possess long-time expertise in supplying components for critical applications like Valves
for Cryogenic and other severe services.

We have an array of dedicated suppliers for Machining, Foundry and Assembly. Also, basic assemblies
are done in-house. Total quality inspections are carried out by our qualified inspectors including
PMI.

of them. We are "Green" - Our premise is totally running on Solar Power - We care for our

## CRYO

CRANE Cryogenics™ brings together the trusted capabilities of Crane®, CRYOWorks®, and Technifab®
brands – forming a leading force in cryogenic engineering, manufacturing, and service excellence.

[CONTACT OUR EXPERTS][67]
[LEARN MORE][68]

## CRYOLinks®
## MAX

Introducing CryoLinks® MAX, a pre-engineered rigid piping system that enables safer and more
cost-effective cryogenic handling. It is available in custom lengths up to 40 feet and with inner
lines of up to 24″ NPS.

[Contact Our Experts][69]

## CRYOGENIC
## EQUIPMENT
## MANUFACTURING

## VALVES

Crane Cryogenics™ Vacuum Jacketed, Bellows Seal Globe, Lift-Check, and Butterfly Valves minimize

of Crane® valve technology.

sector.

## CRYO

CRANE Cryogenics™ brings together the trusted capabilities of Crane®, CRYOWorks®, and Technifab®
brands – forming a leading force in cryogenic engineering, manufacturing, and service excellence.

[CONTACT OUR EXPERTS][67]
[LEARN MORE][68]

## CRYOLinks®
## MAX

Introducing CryoLinks® MAX, a pre-engineered rigid piping system that enables safer and more
cost-effective cryogenic handling. It is available in custom lengths up to 40 feet and with inner
lines of up to 24″ NPS.

[Contact Our Experts][69]
[LEARN MORE][70]

## CRYOGENIC
## EQUIPMENT
## MANUFACTURING

From simple flex hoses to complex piping systems, Crane Cryogenics™ ensures comprehensive coverage
for the storage, distribution, and transfer of all cryogenic fluids.

[CONTACT OUR EXPERTS][71]

## CRYOGENIC
## VALVES

Crane Cryogenics™ Vacuum Jacketed, Bellows Seal Globe, Lift-Check, and Butterfly Valves minimize
heat transfer rates, reduce pipeline latency in liquid transfer applications, and leverage 170 years
of Crane® valve technology.

FASTER LEAD TIMES. MORE CAPACITY. UNMATCHED SUPPORT

## CRANE CRYOGENICS DELIVERS.

As CRANE Cryogenics™, we are leveraging the combined strengths of our legacy brands to become a
leader in the cryogenics industry. Our customers can expect an expanded portfolio of equipment and
services, along with a dedicated team of experts who understand the unique needs of the cryogenics
sector.

With locations in California, Texas, and Indiana, we are well-positioned to provide short lead times
and exceptional service across North America.

### [How do valves withstand the challenge of corrosion during long-term exposure to seawater][173]

In marine engineering, offshore platforms, and seawater systems, valves operate in a unique
environment. Seawater, salt spray, high humidity, and continuous operation cycles combine to create
a long-term service environment. In this context, a frequently overlooked fact is that the greatest
enemy of marine operations is not pressure, but time.
[ Learn More ][174]
[ [Best Practices for Valve Maintenance in Low Temperature Service] ][175]
MediaCompany News

### [Best Practices for Valve Maintenance in Low-Temperature Service][176]

Valves play a vital role in modern production and daily life, serving everything from mild operating
conditions to extreme industrial environments. Cryogenic valves are primarily used in applications
such as ethylene plants, liquefied natural gas (LNG) facilities, natural gas/LPG/LNG storage tanks
and receiving terminals, air separation units, and petrochemical tail-gas separation equipment.
[ Learn More ][177]
[ [Why do some qualified valves leak as soon as they are warmed up] ][178]
MediaCompany News

### [Why do some qualified valves leak as soon as they are warmed up?][179]

Cryogenic valves are typically used to handle extremely low temperatures and often high pressures,
such as liquefied natural gas, liquid oxygen, and liquid hydrogen. Cryogenic valve testing is a
crucial step in ensuring their safe, reliable, and efficient operation under extreme conditions. In
actual production, we sometimes encounter situations where rigorously tested cryogenic valves leak
as soon as they are warmed up. Is this due to insufficient testing? Of course not.
[ Learn More ][180]

## [About Us][29]

# [ Nantong High & Medium Pressure Valve Co., Ltd.][30]

[

TH-Valve Nantong was founded in 1965. We are specialized in producing gate valve, globe valve, check
valve, ball valve, cryogenic/low temperature valves, strainer, plug valve, with a diameter range
from 2” to 72” and pressure class from 150LB to 4500LB. TH-Valve Nantong have been exporting since
1989, and gradually acquired the certificates of API 6D, API 600,API 6FA, API 607,API 6FD, PED/CE,
TR-CU and ATEX for European market, CRN for Canada etc. No matter where you are in the world, we are
more than happy to provide you with quality products and professional services.

# Cryocomp Cryogenic Valves & Vacuum Components

[cryogenic valves and vacuum components]

### Enhance Your Cryogenic System with

Cryo Valves ⏷ Vacuum Evacuation Valves and Operators ⏷ Cold Box Valves ⏷ Vapor Vents and Vent
Heaters ⏷ Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

Cryocomp specializes in vacuum insulated equipment for the safe and efficient transfer of cryogenic
liquids like liquid nitrogen, helium, argon, oxygen, and hydrogen. We make standard and custom
valves, bayonet connections, and evacuation components for vacuum jacketed piping systems and
containers. See our [Vacuum Piping System Design Overview][41] and find out how each component can
work in a cryogenic system configuration.

### Cryogenic Valves

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][42]

Cryocomp manufactures liquid nitrogen valves, liquid helium valves, and cryogenic solenoid valves in
virtually any configuration required. Valves are available from ½” to 2.0″ diameters in manual and
actuated, remote on/off, and flow control configurations. Our cryo valves have internal stem
assemblies and stainless-steel bodies that are also interchangeable, thus simplifying any needed
repairs, maintenance, or upgrades in the field.

### Vacuum Evacuation Valves & Operators

[[vacuum valves][vacuum valves]][43]
Important to the design of any cryogenic system are the vacuum evacuation valves and seal-off
valves. The valves are sized according to the enclosure dimensions and available from ¼” to 3.0″
diameters. We make matching seal-off valve operator tools for manipulation and positive sealing of
the valves. Our valves improve vacuum reliability and reduce product cost, with features like
flanged ends, spring-loaded action, and side ports available.

### Custom Manifolds

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual][cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][44]

Valve manifold assemblies can be as unique as the application. Most will include multiple valves.
These can be manual operation valves, actuated valves, or solenoid valves. Additionally, check
valves, pressure relief valves, bayonet connections, VJ piping, and elbows are useful and can be
incorporated into the design.

### Flexlines

[[cryogenic flexlines][cryogenic flexlines]][45]
This is an indispensable accessory for the safe and efficient transfer of liquid cryogens, including
liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, liquid argon, and liquid oxygen. Cryogenic transfer lines range from
the simplest non-jacketed flex line to a high-efficiency vacuum encased system. Cryogenic transfer
lines are available from Cryofab.

### Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

[[cryogenic bayonets][cryogenic bayonets]][46]
The bayonet set is a two-part mechanical joint that connects sections of vacuum jacketed pipe. Using
vacuum insulated bayonet connections allows for quick field installation of VJ piping systems with
minimum heat loss. Cryocomp bayonets’ features ensure continuous leak-free operation and minimal
heat loss.

## Buy with Confidence

Cryocomp has resources to help you research your options and specify the product that best fits your
needs. See [How to Specify a Cryogenic Valve.][47]

## Let Us Be Your Supplier of Cryogenic Valves, Cryogenic Vacuum Valves, and Cryogenic Bayonets

Each application and every customer are important to the experienced engineers and personnel at
Cryocomp Valves and our parent company, Cryofab Inc. Please allow us the opportunity to work with
you to develop the most efficient approaches to your cryogenic and vacuum systems challenges.
Contact us today at [sale@tooltalkshow.com][48]

# Cryocomp Cryogenic Valves & Vacuum Components

[cryogenic valves and vacuum components]

### Enhance Your Cryogenic System with

Cryo Valves ⏷ Vacuum Evacuation Valves and Operators ⏷ Cold Box Valves ⏷ Vapor Vents and Vent
Heaters ⏷ Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

Cryocomp specializes in vacuum insulated equipment for the safe and efficient transfer of cryogenic
liquids like liquid nitrogen, helium, argon, oxygen, and hydrogen. We make standard and custom
valves, bayonet connections, and evacuation components for vacuum jacketed piping systems and
containers. See our [Vacuum Piping System Design Overview][41] and find out how each component can
work in a cryogenic system configuration.

### Cryogenic Valves

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][42]

Cryocomp manufactures liquid nitrogen valves, liquid helium valves, and cryogenic solenoid valves in
virtually any configuration required. Valves are available from ½” to 2.0″ diameters in manual and
actuated, remote on/off, and flow control configurations. Our cryo valves have internal stem
assemblies and stainless-steel bodies that are also interchangeable, thus simplifying any needed
repairs, maintenance, or upgrades in the field.

### Vacuum Evacuation Valves & Operators

[[vacuum valves][vacuum valves]][43]
Important to the design of any cryogenic system are the vacuum evacuation valves and seal-off
valves. The valves are sized according to the enclosure dimensions and available from ¼” to 3.0″
diameters. We make matching seal-off valve operator tools for manipulation and positive sealing of
the valves. Our valves improve vacuum reliability and reduce product cost, with features like
flanged ends, spring-loaded action, and side ports available.

### Custom Manifolds

[[cryogenic valves, actuated and manual][cryogenic valves, actuated and manual]][44]

Valve manifold assemblies can be as unique as the application. Most will include multiple valves.
These can be manual operation valves, actuated valves, or solenoid valves. Additionally, check
valves, pressure relief valves, bayonet connections, VJ piping, and elbows are useful and can be
incorporated into the design.

### Flexlines

[[cryogenic flexlines][cryogenic flexlines]][45]
This is an indispensable accessory for the safe and efficient transfer of liquid cryogens, including
liquid helium, liquid nitrogen, liquid argon, and liquid oxygen. Cryogenic transfer lines range from
the simplest non-jacketed flex line to a high-efficiency vacuum encased system. Cryogenic transfer
lines are available from Cryofab.

### Vacuum Insulated Bayonets

[[cryogenic bayonets][cryogenic bayonets]][46]
The bayonet set is a two-part mechanical joint that connects sections of vacuum jacketed pipe. Using
vacuum insulated bayonet connections allows for quick field installation of VJ piping systems with
minimum heat loss. Cryocomp bayonets’ features ensure continuous leak-free operation and minimal
heat loss.

## Buy with Confidence

Cryocomp has resources to help you research your options and specify the product that best fits your
needs. See [How to Specify a Cryogenic Valve.][47]

## Let Us Be Your Supplier of Cryogenic Valves, Cryogenic Vacuum Valves, and Cryogenic Bayonets

Each application and every customer are important to the experienced engineers and personnel at
Cryocomp Valves and our parent company, Cryofab Inc. Please allow us the opportunity to work with
you to develop the most efficient approaches to your cryogenic and vacuum systems challenges.
Contact us today at [sale@tooltalkshow.com][48]

#### *Accelerating Innovation | Delivering Tomorrow*

# Welcome to Triton Space Technologies

Triton Space Technologies is a leading aerospace manufacturer specializing in the design,
development, and manufacturing of spaceflight propulsion components for the commercial space
industry. We provide both off-the-shelf and custom propulsion hardware for spacecraft, launch
vehicles, and in-space systems requiring high-reliability, flight-critical components.

It is our goal to delight our customers by providing exceptional responsiveness, speed, hardware and
quality. What sets Triton Space Technologies apart is our fast engineering response and short
manufacturing lead times. We routinely deliver flight-ready spaceflight hardware in weeks instead of
months, enabling customers to move quickly from design to integration to launch.

# Engine & Fluid System Components

We specialize in off-the-shelf feed system components and hardware developed specifically to meet
the needs of the commercial spaceflight industry. [Our Products][74] include a variety of
high-quality hardware specifically designed for rocket propulsion systems, including: [Solenoid
Valves][75], [Latching Solenoid Valves][76], [Pilot-Actuated Solenoid Valves][77], [Pyrotechnically
Actuated Valves][78] and [Pyrotechnic Initiators][79]. Additionally, we provide valves for specific
applications, including: [Cryogenic Valves][80], [Hypergol Compatible Valves][81], [Latch
Valves][82], [Miniature Valves][83] and [Satellite Valves][84]. Our products are available with
short lead times in standard, off-the-shelf, configurations. However, if you have a specific
requirement or alteration that is needed, these can usually be accommodated in a timely manner.

Triton Space Technologies designs and manufactures non-toxic spacecraft [Propulsion Systems][85] and
flight-critical hardware for the commercial space industry. With more than a decade of experience in
rocket engine design, manufacturing, and testing, we specialize in liquid nitrous oxide propulsion
architectures that deliver high performance with simplified handling and operations.

We are currently developing a family of custom in-space propulsion thruster assemblies optimized for

# Vervo: Leading Valve Manufacturer in China

[Vervo Valve Factory: Ball Valves]

**VERVO Valve** is a professional **valve manufacturing enterprise** integrating R&D, production,
and sales. Our product portfolio includes a comprehensive range of valves and accessories — such as
gate valves, globe valves, ball valves, check valves, butterfly valves, plug valves, and strainers —
which are widely used in the oil and gas, refinery, petrochemical, and many other industries
worldwide.

As a leading **valve manufacturer** in China, VERVO has built an outstanding reputation for
delivering high-quality products. To uphold this reputation, all valves are manufactured in strict
compliance with certified management systems and industry standards, including ISO 9001 (GB/T
19001-2016/ISO 9001:2015), OHSMS (GB/T 45001-2020/ISO 45001:2018), and the environmental management
system (GB/T 24001-2016/ISO 14001:2015). We also hold essential industry certifications such as, 622
(including STD 624-2023), CE (PED), EAC (TR TC 010/2011, TR TC 032/2013), and ISO 15848-1, ensuring
full compliance with global market requirements.

Driven by an unwavering commitment to providing superior products and tailored services that meet
diverse customer needs, VERVO has established itself as a key player in the global valve industry.
We respond to customer requests faster and more efficiently than ever before, positioning ourselves
as your ideal partner for all valve-related requirements.

In addition to standard valve models, VERVO also supplies a wide range of specialty valves designed
for harsh service conditions — including HF acid, sour gas, cryogenic, chlorine, and oxygen
applications. Our products, available in various materials, are manufactured in accordance with
internationally recognized standards such as , ANSI, DIN, BS, and JIS.

## Company Profile

Established in 1998, we are a leading valve manufacturer with six production bases across Wenzhou,
Tianjin, and Lishui, specializing in R&D, casting, precision manufacturing, and delivering valve
solutions worldwide.

[xintai factory overview]

## Headquarters

#### Leading The Global Valve Industry

Founded in 1998, we design and manufacture high-performance ball, gate, globe, check and butterfly
valves for oil, gas, chemical, and defense, power stations, water treatment and other related
application areas. Our headquarters located in Wenzhou, we hold ISO and API certifications operate
advanced inspection centers, and supply global leaders like Petronas and Petrobras.

[About Us][96]
[xintai factory]

## Foundry

#### Precision Casting, Reliable Performance, Broad Applications

Located in Xiaowei Park, our 25,298mỉ foundry produces over ¥450 million annually. Operating since
2019, it specializes in silica sol and composite casting of valves, auto parts, and machinery. With
3,500+ valve molds, we ensure efficiency, consistency, and product diversity.

[About Us][97]

## Production Base

#### Strong Foundation, Steady Output, Trusted Supply

Built in 2010 in Longwan District, this 9,800㎡ facility delivers over ¥100 million annually. It
plays a key role in manufacturing valve components and supporting XINTAI’s national and
international supply chain with stable production and efficient output.

[About Us][98]
[xintai company and team]

## Skilled Team

#### Expert Engineers, Full Support, Every Stage

Our 580 employees include 33 engineers, 41 testers, and 25 quality managers. Supported by 32 sales
and 8 after-sales experts, this dedicated team powers XINTAI’s product development, customer
satisfaction, and technical service excellence around the world.

[About Us][99]
[xintai inspection center]

## Inspection Center

#### Quality First, Every Valve Inspected Thoroughly

Located in Yongjia, our valve testing and experiment center ensures strict quality control. With
professional-grade testing equipment, we provide reliable validation for sealing, pressure
resistance, and performance, supporting industries that demand absolute precision and safety.

[About Us][100]

## Smart Manufacturing Excellence

[Casting][101] [Air Drying][102] [Automation][103] [Precision Crafting][104] [Slurry Coating][105]
Casting
Each valve body starts in casting, where alloy steel is shaped under 1500°C to meet high-pressure
tolerance standards.
[See Innovation in Action][106]
Air Drying
Air drying stabilizes moisture content under 5%, preparing parts for coating or adhesive bonding
without deformation.
[See Innovation in Action][107]
Automated Precision
13 six-axis robots handle polishing and inspection, improving efficiency by 40% and reducing manual
defects.
[See Innovation in Action][108]
Precision Crafting
Utilizes CNC and robotic systems to achieve micron-level accuracy in valve components, enhancing
sealing performance and operational reliability.
[See Innovation in Action][109]
Slurry Coating
Precision-applied slurry forms a barrier against chemical attack, extending part life in
petrochemical processing lines.
[See Innovation in Action][110]
[xintai valve surface treatment]

## Industrial Strength

Built on scale and precision, our nationwide facilities deliver high-volume valve production with
advanced foundry and machining capabilities.

[robotic hand]
10 Casting Lines
leading Wenzhou’s casting industry with 15 production lines planned for 2025.
[valve symbol]

[building logo]
270K Output
producing over 270,000 valves yearly, among Wenzhou’s largest.
[global]
6 Production Bases
two casting and four precision machining bases across China.

At Atlas Copco, we’re not just innovators; we’re your partners in compressor reliability.

## The patented StraightFlo™ compressor valve with
## Modular Reed Technology:

## HERE'S HOW IT WORKS

[StraightFlo™][44] reciprocating compressor valves are drop-in replacements for OEM valves in
reciprocating compressors operating at speeds from 200 to 3,600+ rpm, pressure differentials up to
4,350 psi (300 bar), and service temperatures from -40° to 500°F (-40° to 260°C). They deliver
exceptional performance and unmatched value for compressors in oil & [gas applications][45], as well
as in air, nitrogen, and hydrogen industrial gas services.

With traditional compressor valves, sealing elements are typically spring-actuated polymer plates,
concentric rings, or poppets where the gas flowing through the inlet valve ports directly impacts
the sealing elements and is then redirected multiple times before it can exit the outlet valve
ports. This flow redirection creates a tortuous path for the gas, resulting in significant pressure
drop across the valve.

Patented of StraightFlo™ valves feature a radically different and substantially better design. Their
interchangeable, enhanced reed valve modules allow straight, unobstructed gas flow, resulting in the
lowest pressure drop (highest efficiency) for a given valve diameter.

StraightFlo™ reed valve modules are held stationary between the valve seat and carrier. Components
do not move or impact the metal housings, so normal wear-and-tear is completely contained inside the
modules. This robust design makes StraightFlo™ valves more durable in operation and more tolerant of
liquids and debris. They routinely transform service intervals of weeks or months into multi-year
run times.

StraightFlo™ valves also provide a wide range of benefits to support your net-zero initiatives,
including:
* [ Up to 15% emissions reduction ][46]
* Up to 15% lower power consumption
* Elimination of multiple blowdown, purging, and flaring events
* 10X less vibration
* 6-8 dB lower noise levels
* Lower carbon footprint from fewer service call-outs
* Reduced energy and materials waste by eliminating valve machining

** All valve performance statements are based on documented case studies.*

## A PROVEN PIPELINE TO GREATER PROFIT & PERFORMANCE

With Atlas Copco, discover the broad range of unmatched benefits exceptional engineering can achieve
— from increased operational and financial performance to meaningful improvements in your ESG
initiatives.

Join the future of reciprocating compressor valves with Atlas Copco. Our [StraightFlo™ SS][47] and
[StraightFlo™ SE][48] valves are engineered to tackle the toughest environments, ensuring
reliability and cost savings.

## HERE'S HOW IT WORKS

[StraightFlo™][44] reciprocating compressor valves are drop-in replacements for OEM valves in
reciprocating compressors operating at speeds from 200 to 3,600+ rpm, pressure differentials up to
4,350 psi (300 bar), and service temperatures from -40° to 500°F (-40° to 260°C). They deliver
exceptional performance and unmatched value for compressors in oil & [gas applications][45], as well
as in air, nitrogen, and hydrogen industrial gas services.

With traditional compressor valves, sealing elements are typically spring-actuated polymer plates,
concentric rings, or poppets where the gas flowing through the inlet valve ports directly impacts
the sealing elements and is then redirected multiple times before it can exit the outlet valve
ports. This flow redirection creates a tortuous path for the gas, resulting in significant pressure
drop across the valve.

Patented of StraightFlo™ valves feature a radically different and substantially better design. Their
interchangeable, enhanced reed valve modules allow straight, unobstructed gas flow, resulting in the
lowest pressure drop (highest efficiency) for a given valve diameter.

StraightFlo™ reed valve modules are held stationary between the valve seat and carrier. Components
do not move or impact the metal housings, so normal wear-and-tear is completely contained inside the
modules. This robust design makes StraightFlo™ valves more durable in operation and more tolerant of
liquids and debris. They routinely transform service intervals of weeks or months into multi-year
run times.

StraightFlo™ valves also provide a wide range of benefits to support your net-zero initiatives,
including:
* [ Up to 15% emissions reduction ][46]
* Up to 15% lower power consumption
* Elimination of multiple blowdown, purging, and flaring events
* 10X less vibration
* 6-8 dB lower noise levels
* Lower carbon footprint from fewer service call-outs
* Reduced energy and materials waste by eliminating valve machining

** All valve performance statements are based on documented case studies.*

## ABOUT US

Atlas Copco was established as a groundbreaking innovator in the global compressor valve market.
Atlas Copco develops, manufactures, and sells reciprocating compressor valves, unloaders, and
associated products.

Atlas Copco developed its disruptive and unique StraightFlo^{TM} compressor valve using its
[patented][62] Modular Reed Valve technology. The StraightFlo^{TM} compressor valve provides
[superior performance and reliability][63], exceptional cost savings, and lower emissions as
compared to conventional reciprocating gas compressor valves.

Atlas Copco products are used in a wide range of applications, including oil & gas (upstream,
midstream and downstream), chemical processing, industrial gases, air, refrigeration, and more.
